theme_archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY & INSTITUTIONAL HERITAGE (Premium British Educational Institute)
aesthetic_direction: Established, credible, elegant and modern British/International educational institute aesthetic. Restrained institutional palette, warm ivory/cream surfaces, deep royal navy structure, and subtle brass/gold accents. Sharp subtle geometry, refined borders, clear typography hierarchy.

colors.palette_summary: Deep Royal Navy (#0A192F / #112240) structure, Ivory/Cream (#FAF8F5 / #F4F0E8) background surfaces, Rich Gold/Brass (#C59B27 / #B8860B) accents, Slate/Navy text tones.

typography.pairing: Cinzel / Playfair Display / Cormorant Garamond for Headings (Serif / Academic Heritage) + Inter / Plus Jakarta Sans for Body Data & UI

hierarchy.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-serif font-bold text-slate-900 tracking-tight
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-serif font-semibold text-slate-900 tracking-tight
hierarchy.caption: text-xs text-slate-500 font-sans

spacing_and_layout.density: Moderate-high institutional density with generous section padding (p-6 to p-8), defined grid boundaries, 1px subtle brass/beige borders, crisp concentric corners.
spacing_and_layout.radius_rule: rounded-md (6px) or rounded-sm (4px) maximum. Strictly avoid excessive rounded pill cards (rounded-2xl/3xl forbidden for admin containers).
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: Mode B High-Density Dashboard Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-5

AppLayout.sidebar: Deep Royal Navy background (#0A192F), fine 1px gold trim border-r (#C59B27/20), institutional header crest/logo with subtle gold icon badge, active item highlighted with gold left accent border and warm dark-blue background.
AppLayout.topbar: Warm Ivory/White surface, subtle bottom border (#E6E1D7), clear user identity pill with role badge, clean logout trigger with tooltip.
AppLayout.page_container: Ivory background (#FAF8F5) with structured content spacing (max-w-7xl mx-auto p-6 md:p-8).

PageHeader.style: Academic serif page title with gold sub-line accent, muted description, and primary brass/navy CTA button.

DashboardPage.stat_cards: Ivory/White solid card background with subtle gold hover glow, top border gold accent line (border-t-2 border-amber-600/40), high-contrast metric typography (text-3xl font-bold font-serif), contextual metric labels.

ExaminationsListPage.filters: Refined select inputs with warm background and crisp focus rings.
ExaminationsListPage.table: Institutional data table: navy header text with ivory background, alternating light row hover states, crisp borders, gold/navy detail action links.

ExaminationDetailPage.tabs: Classic underline tab list with brass highlight bar (border-b-2 border-amber-600) for active tab, high clarity tab contents for Subjects, Registrations, Results.

StatusBadge.styling: Restrained semantic badges with border trim: active/valid/completed = emerald background with deep green text; scheduled/pending = amber background with dark brown text; rejected/cancelled = rose background with dark red text.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Subtle 150ms ease-in-out transitions, gentle background lift without disruptive layout shifts.
motion_and_interactions.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all CSS and motion animations.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST retain or add data-testid attributes using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='examination-create-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply deep navy (#0A192F), ivory (#FAF8F5), and gold/brass (#C59B27) CSS variable tokens inside /app/frontend/src/index.css.
Update tailwind.config.js to include font families (Playfair Display / Serif) and institutional color tokens if needed.
Redesign AppLayout.jsx with the deep navy sidebar, gold accents, and warm topbar shell.
Redesign PageHeader.jsx and StatusBadge.jsx for consistent academic styling.
Redesign DashboardPage.jsx with institutional stat tiles and gold border accents.
Redesign ExaminationsListPage.jsx and ExaminationDetailPage.jsx (plus its sub-tabs and dialogs) according to the new visual system.
Ensure all data-testid attributes remain intact for end-to-end automated testing.
